kicker: Extropic Z1T on a sampling chip

scenes.headline: How a transformer runs on a chip that samples
scenes.sub: Extropic's Z1T rebuilds a transformer around 16 fixed neighbours per bit.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wombat! The Z1 chip doesn't multiply matrices. It computes by sampling. Here's how Z1T fits a transformer onto it.

scenes.text: Z1 computes by sampling, not multiplying. Z1T keeps a transformer's block shape and rebuilds every primitive inside it around 16 fixed neighbours per bit.

scenes.title: One pbit, sampled
scenes.text: E[v | h] = tanh(b + Σ J_j h_j)
scenes.say: Z1 is a fabric of pbits: random bits, each wired to sixteen fixed neighbours.

parts.note: 16 hardwired neighbours, weighted by their couplings
parts.say: Weight the neighbours' states by their couplings.

parts.note: the nonlinearity a network wants, sampled not computed
parts.say: The average is a tanh: the nonlinearity a network wants, sampled, not computed.

parts.note: one draw is one bit, so average many draws
parts.say: One draw is one bit, so reading out a number means averaging many draws.

left.title: Standard transformer block
items: Softmax attention over a dense score matrix
left.say: A standard block assumes dense reach: a norm, dense feed-forward layers, softmax attention.

right.title: Z1T block
items: Dynamic Tanh in place of RMSNorm
right.say: Z1T swaps the norm for a tanh, the feed-forward for sparse tanh-linear units, and attention for a gated convolution with no softmax.

scenes.title: A token through Z1 and an FPGA

steps.say: Z1 can't do embeddings or positions efficiently, so those run on an FPGA on the same board.
The sparse tanh-linear layers and attention gates run on Z1, as sampling.
Residual adds go back to the FPGA, block after block.

steps.note: the FPGA spends over 95% of the energy
steps.say: The FPGA also projects to logits. In this first version, it spends over ninety-five percent of the energy.

scenes.title: H100 energy per token over Z1T's, by utilization
scenes.note: projected energy on both sides, not measured on Z1
scenes.say: The over a hundred times claim is one row: an H100 at ten percent utilization. At fifty and a hundred percent, it's twenty-eight and fourteen. All projected.

scenes.text: Z1T keeps a transformer's shape and rebuilds its layers so sixteen fixed wires can sample them; the FPGA does the rest.

recap: Z1 samples pbits wired to 16 neighbours
Z1T rebuilds norm, feed-forward and attention to fit
An FPGA handles embeddings, residuals and logits
scenes.say: To recap: a sampling chip, a transformer rebuilt to fit it, and an FPGA for the rest.
